name: tinv
expr: x_s = tinv(0.975, 5); x_v = tinv(ps, 10); x_n1 = tinv(0.975, 1); x_n2 = tinv(0.975, 2); x_inf = tinv(0.975, Inf); x_med_inf = tinv(0.5, Inf); x_p0 = tinv(0, 5); x_p1 = tinv(1, 5); x_pneg = tinv(-0.1, 5); x_pover = tinv(1.5, 5); x_n0 = tinv(0.5, 0); x_nneg = tinv(0.5, -1);
comment: Sig: x = tinv(p, nu). Inverse Student's t-CDF. Uses betaincinv(2(1-p) or 2p, nu/2, 1/2) and signs by p<>0.5. nu=Inf -> Gaussian limit (norminv(p)). Edges: p=0 -> -Inf; p=1 -> +Inf; p outside [0,1] -> NaN; nu<=0 -> NaN.
